test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It may seem __________ that the hours of women’s chores at home have not declined inspite of the availability of many appliances (gas, electric ranges, washing machines, etc.)
solution:
The correct answer is '**perplexing**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**perplexing**" means completely baffling or very puzzling. (उलझाऊ)
 
• It highlights the surprising or confusing fact that the hours of women’s chores have not decreased despite modern appliances.
 
• The other options: "**promising**," "**perceiving**," and "**persisting**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It may seem perplexing__ that the hours of women’s chores at home have not declined in spite of the availability of many appliances (gas, electric ranges, washing machines, etc.).*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Promising (आशाजनक)**: means showing signs of future success.
 
• **Perceiving (अनुभव करना)**: means becoming aware or conscious of something.
 
• **Persisting (दृढ़ रहना)**: means continuing firmly or obstinately in an opinion or course of action.
